title: Expectation under uniform padding
statement: Let $a,r,M$ be natural numbers with $a\le r$ and $M>0$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the functions from $\{0,\ldots,a-1\}$ to $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$. For a uniformly chosen function $c$ from $\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ to $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$, the expected value of $f$ applied to the restriction of $c$ to the first $a$ positions equals the uniform expectation of $f$ over functions on the first $a$ positions.
